name: Kevin T Burton
occupation: Teacher--Sciences, Math, Career and Technical Education

bio.statement: In his voters' pamphlet statement, Burton lists his occupation as teacher of sciences, math, and career and technical education.
bio.excerpt: Occupation: Teacher--Sciences, Math, Career and Technical Education

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Nov 3 2026 Voters' Pamphlet (edition Book4)

bio.statement: His statement lists Southwestern Oregon Community College and the University of Oregon as his educational background.
bio.excerpt: Southwestern Oregon Community College, University of Oregon

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Nov 3 2026 Voters' Pamphlet (edition Book4)

bio.statement: His statement lists precinct committee person since 1992 and chair of a non-profit living history organization, 2000-2014, as prior governmental experience.
bio.excerpt: Precinct Committee person since1992. Chair of non-profit living history organization, 2000-2014.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Nov 3 2026 Voters' Pamphlet (edition Book4)

bio.statement: He says he is a life-long Oregonian, born in Nyssa and raised along the I-5 corridor and on the coast.
bio.excerpt: I am a life-long Oregonian, born in Nyssa

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Nov 3 2026 Voters' Pamphlet (edition Book4)

positions.statement: Burton says his plan is to reinstitute responsible timber use and forest management and to reduce hunting and fishing license fees to encourage more tourism.
positions.excerpt: My plan is to reinstitute responsible timber use and forest management and to reduce hunting and fishing license fees to encourage more tourism

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Nov 3 2026 Voters' Pamphlet (edition Book4)

positions.statement: He says teachers must be allowed to discipline students and that funds need to go to classrooms more than administration.
positions.excerpt: Teachers must be allowed to discipline students. Funds need to go to classrooms more than administration.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Nov 3 2026 Voters' Pamphlet (edition Book4)

positions.statement: He says schools should focus on core subjects and return music, art, and career and technical courses.
positions.excerpt: Schools should focus on core subjects and return music, art, and career and technical courses.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Nov 3 2026 Voters' Pamphlet (edition Book4)

positions.statement: He says attempts to increase transportation costs and to criminalize standard farming and ranching practices (PEACE Act) hurt rural families.
positions.excerpt: Attempts to increase transportation costs and to criminalize standard farming and ranching practices (PEACE Act) hurt these families

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Nov 3 2026 Voters' Pamphlet (edition Book4)
